title: Video Editor & Graphic Designer
description:
We are looking for a creative and detail-oriented Video Editor and Graphic Designer to join our team. The candidate will be responsible for creating engaging videos and visually appealing graphics for social media, marketing campaigns, and educational/promotional content. Key Responsibilities: Edit and assemble raw video footage into polished, professional videos. Add effects, transitions, voiceovers, and background music as needed. Create attractive posters, thumbnails, banners, and social media creatives. Collaborate with the marketing and content team to bring creative ideas to life. Ensure brand consistency across all visuals. Proficiency in software like Adobe Premiere Pro, After Effects, Photoshop, Illustrator, Canva (or similar tools). Location: Karol Bagh Experience: 0 -1 year *Immediate joiners are most welcome* If you are interested for this role, Kindly apply or mail at hr@argasia.in Contact -8595907566/ 7678651357

Key Skills: graphic designer,marketing,adobe premiere pro,premiere pro,social media creatives,video editor,after effects,hr
